source.name: AC Milan, 'AC MILAN AND BITPANDA EXPAND PARTNERSHIP WITH NEW BACK OF SHIRT SPONSORSHIP'
source.quote: Bitpanda will serve as the new Back-of-Shirt sponsor for the men's First Team , joining AC Milan's family of Principal Partners .

note: Expansion of a partnership begun in summer 2024 (Premium Partner and Official Crypto Trading Partner). End date and value not disclosed; SempreMilan reported Sole 24 Ore figures for the back-of-shirt deal but the article could not be opened to quote.
